items.answer: Websites have fixed package prices: Starter $300, Business $500, and Premium from $700. No hourly billing, no surprises.

items.answer: Every product is different, so SaaS platforms and MVPs get one fixed price in your proposal, agreed before we start. No hourly billing, no surprises.

notes: What this means for you: where Stripe isn’t an option, we connect PayPal or another provider that works in your country, and we confirm the right one with you before we build.

example.heading: How GulfNurseries was built to pay for itself
example.lead: A client project: one directory covering 3,000+ nurseries across all six GCC countries.

points.title: The problem
points.text: Parents had no single place to compare nurseries. Information was scattered across social media, outdated listings and word of mouth.

points.title: How it earns
points.text: Listings are free to claim, which gets owners to keep them up to date. Paid plans and advertising then give owners more visibility.

points.title: How people use it
points.text: Parents search by city and neighbourhood on a map, compare fees and curriculum, then call or WhatsApp in one tap. In the Gulf, that’s how people contact a business.

points.title: How it gets found
points.text: Parent guides on licensing, starting age and choosing a nursery are written to rank in search, so growth doesn’t depend only on ads.

arabic.heading: What “Arabic done right” actually means

rows.ours: Setting the direction in the HTML, as the W3C recommends, so the layout mirrors properly

rows.shortcut: English titles left on Arabic pages

rows.shortcut: Forms and error messages still in English
rows.ours: Buttons, forms and error messages in the language of the page

rows.shortcut: Arabic squeezed into sizes set for English

arabic.proof: You can see this on the site you’re reading.

maps.heading: Getting into the map box on Google
paragraphs: We reviewed 54 Google results pages across the six GCC countries in November 2026. Every “web design company” search we checked for Dubai, Riyadh and Doha showed a map box of three local businesses above the regular results. Your customers’ searches for “clinic in Riyadh” or “restaurant in Dubai” work in a similar way.

A business usually needs a real address and a Google Business Profile to appear there. That’s why every package includes Google Business setup: you have the address, so this is an opening a website alone can’t reach. Google decides who appears, so nobody can honestly promise you a place in it.

items.question: How long does it take to build a website?
items.answer: Starter and Business go live in 1 week. Premium depends on your project. Timelines count business days, Sunday to Thursday, from when we have your content.

items.question: Do you work with businesses in the Gulf without a local office?
items.answer: Yes. We work fully remotely, by video, WhatsApp and email, across Gulf time zones.

items.question: What happens to my current website?
items.answer: It stays online until the new one is ready. Your content and domain come with you, and we redirect your old pages to protect your Google rankings.

items.question: Can you build an online store?
items.answer: Yes. Stores are part of the Business and Premium packages. They can take bank transfer and cash on delivery, and we can connect Stripe, PayPal or another payment provider that works in your country.

items.question: Can I edit the website myself after launch?
items.answer: Yes, if you want to. Tell us on the first call and we’ll set it up for easy editing. Or send us your changes under the care plan.

items.question: Will my website rank on Google?
items.answer: Nobody can honestly guarantee a ranking. Every package includes SEO setup, and Business and Premium go further. Rankings then depend on your market and your content.
